summary: WebESS - Time and Attendance � Employees Without Overtime Records Are Displayed
task:
WebESS - Time and Attendance � Employees Without Overtime Records Are Displayed
In the WebESS **Overtime** tab, employees with **Overtime Eligible = Yes** are displayed even when they have no overtime records within the selected date range. **Example:** For **24 Aug � 28 Aug**, only Danh has overtime records in F&O. ![image.png](https://dev.azure.com/gemseducation/c153c9a8-3abc-4dd1-b615-03f718b00c76/_apis/wit/attachments/7792ea47-e858-49ac-841f-25dfacac07f9?fileName=image.png) However, WebESS also displays Hammad, Long, and Ruchika with 0 overtime. ![image.png](https://dev.azure.com/gemseducation/c153c9a8-3abc-4dd1-b615-03f718b00c76/_apis/wit/attachments/71ca798f-db86-47b5-9261-fa1d88c35361?fileName=image.png) **Expected Behavior:** Only employees who have **overtime records within the selected date range** should be displayed in the Overtime tab.

summary: Performance Management � Enhancement � Goal Review Supporting Attachments
task:
Performance Management � Enhancement � Goal Review Supporting Attachments
Enhance the **Performance Management � Goal Review** process on WebESS to support attachments for supporting evidence. Users should be able to provide supporting documents, such as **certificates, emails, or other relevant evidence**, as part of the Goal Review process. The detailed WebESS behaviour and implementation approach will be confirmed separately.
